claim: The four accelerators differ mainly in who schedules a tile and how the tile moves between memory and compute resources.
question: How does one tile progress through each accelerator execution model?
audience: Readers entering the cross-architecture learning path
scope: One aligned overview of NVIDIA GPU, Groq TSP, Tenstorrent Tensix, and Google TPU; no microarchitectural detail
readingOrder: Read the four small multiples left to right; within every card, read schedule owner, memory path, and compute destination from top to bottom
